title: ZERO
subTitle: 从零开始，写到零为止
bottomText: ZERO · 用 GitHub Issues 写的博客
style:
<style>@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Newsreader:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..72,300..600;1,6..72,300..500&family=Noto+Serif+SC:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');

:root{--z-paper:#f6f5f1;--z-card:#fbfaf7;--z-ink:#1b1b1a;--z-ink-2:#5c5b55;--z-ink-3:#8e8c84;--z-rule:#e2e0d8;--z-accent:#8a6f4a;--z-code-bg:#efeee8;--z-serif:'Newsreader','Noto Serif SC',Georgia,'Songti SC',serif;--z-sans:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;--z-mono:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;}
html[data-color-mode="dark"]{--z-paper:#101011;--z-card:#17171a;--z-ink:#e9e8e3;--z-ink-2:#a5a49c;--z-ink-3:#77766e;--z-rule:#28282c;--z-accent:#c9a066;--z-code-bg:#1b1b1f;}

body{max-width:720px;margin:0 auto;padding:72px 28px 104px;font-family:var(--z-sans);font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.82;background:var(--z-paper);color:var(--z-ink);text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;}

#header{align-items:flex-end;padding-bottom:18px;margin-bottom:34px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--z-rule);}
.avatar{width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid var(--z-rule);border-radius:10px;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);}
.avatar:hover{transform:scale(1.06) rotate(-5deg);}
.title-left a{font-family:var(--z-serif);font-size:36px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.16em;margin-left:14px;color:var(--z-ink);}
.title-right button,.title-right .circle{padding:9px 11px;color:var(--z-ink-3);transition:color .2s;}
.title-right button:hover,.title-right .circle:hover{color:var(--z-ink);}
#content>div:first-child{font-family:var(--z-serif);font-size:16px;font-style:italic;color:var(--z-ink-3);margin-bottom:34px;}

.SideNav{min-width:0;border:0;}
.SideNav-item{align-items:baseline;padding:13px 2px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--z-rule);border-radius:0;background:none;transition:background .15s;}
.SideNav-item:hover{background:var(--z-card);}
.listTitle{font-family:var(--z-serif);font-size:19px;font-weight:400;color:var(--z-ink);white-space:normal;overflow:visible;text-overflow:clip;line-height:1.45;max-width:100%;}
.SideNav-icon{display:none;}
.listLabels{gap:7px;}
.Label{font-family:var(--z-sans);font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.04em;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:999px;}
.Label:not(.LabelTime){background:transparent!important;border:1px solid currentColor;}
.Label object a{color:inherit!important;}
.LabelName{color:var(--z-accent)!important;}
.LabelTime{background:transparent!important;color:var(--z-ink-3)!important;border:0;padding:1px 0;}

#footer{margin-top:88px;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid var(--z-rule);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--z-ink-3);line-height:2;}
#footer a{color:var(--z-ink-2);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--z-rule);}
#footer a:hover{color:var(--z-accent);border-color:var(--z-accent);}

.markdown-body{font-family:var(--z-sans);font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--z-ink);}
.markdown-body h1,.markdown-body h2,.markdown-body h3,.markdown-body h4{font-family:var(--z-serif);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.01em;color:var(--z-ink);border:0;padding:0;}
.markdown-body h1{font-size:30px;margin:0 0 26px;}
.markdown-body h2{font-size:23px;margin:54px 0 18px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--z-rule);}
.markdown-body h3{font-size:19px;margin:38px 0 14px;}
.markdown-body a{color:var(--z-accent);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--z-accent) 35%,transparent);}
.markdown-body a:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--z-accent);}
.markdown-body blockquote{margin:26px 0;padding:2px 0 2px 20px;border-left:2px solid var(--z-accent);color:var(--z-ink-2);font-style:normal;background:none;}
.markdown-body blockquote p{font-family:var(--z-serif);font-size:18px;}
.markdown-body code{font-family:var(--z-mono);font-size:.855em;background:var(--z-code-bg);padding:.16em .42em;border-radius:4px;}
.markdown-body pre{background:var(--z-code-bg);border:1px solid var(--z-rule);border-radius:8px;padding:15px 17px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.62;overflow-x:auto;}
.markdown-body pre code{background:none;padding:0;font-size:13.5px;}
.markdown-body table{display:table;width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14.5px;}
.markdown-body table th,.markdown-body table td{border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--z-rule);padding:9px 12px 9px 2px;}
.markdown-body table th{font-family:var(--z-sans);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--z-ink-3);text-transform:uppercase;}
.markdown-body table tr{background:none!important;}
.markdown-body hr{height:1px;background:var(--z-rule);border:0;margin:44px 0;}
.markdown-body img{border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--z-rule);}
.markdown-body strong{font-weight:600;color:var(--z-ink);}
.markdown-body ul,.markdown-body ol{padding-left:1.3em;}
.markdown-body li{margin:.32em 0;}

.pagination a,.pagination span{font-size:14px;color:var(--z-ink-2);}
.tag-box,.Label--large{font-size:13px;}

@media (max-width:640px){
body{padding:40px 16px 72px;font-size:16px;}
.title-left a{font-size:27px;letter-spacing:.13em;}
.markdown-body h1{font-size:25px;}
.markdown-body h2{font-size:21px;}
.markdown-body pre{font-size:12.5px;padding:13px;}
.listTitle{font-size:17px;}
}</style>
